mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, universe_scope, source, content_hash, fetched_at FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE trade_date=#{date} AND universe_scope IN ('SH_SZ_A','FULL_A') GROUP BY source, universe_scope ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN universe_scope='FULL_A' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC
SELECT raw_json FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id, trade_date, universe_scope, source, content_hash, metrics_json, CASE WHEN #{loadRaw} THEN raw_json ELSE NULL END AS raw_json, fetched_at FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE id=( SELECT MAX(id) FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE trade_date=#{date} AND universe_scope='SH_SZ_A' AND source=#{source} )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_breadth_snapshot(trade_date, universe_scope, source, content_hash, metrics_json, raw_json, fetched_at) VALUES(#{tradeDate}, COALESCE(#{universeScope},'SH_SZ_A'), COALESCE(#{source}, 'BAOSTOCK'), #{contentHash}, #{metricsJson}, #{rawJson}, #{fetchedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN bigquant_date IS NOT NULL AND (public_date IS NULL OR bigquant_date >= public_date) THEN 'BIGQUANT' WHEN public_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'BAOSTOCK_SINA' END FROM ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN source='BIGQUANT' THEN trade_date END) AS bigquant_date, MAX(CASE WHEN source='BAOSTOCK_SINA' THEN trade_date END) AS public_date FROM market_breadth_snapshot WHERE universe_scope='FULL_A' AND trade_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{date}, INTERVAL 140 DAY) AND #{date} AND source IN ('BIGQUANT','BAOSTOCK_SINA') AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_json, '$.rosterEvidence.rosterSources')) = 'OBJECT' AND (source='BIGQUANT' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_json, '$.rosterEvidence.comparison')) = 'OBJECT') ) AS latest_history
